name: lifeline-mesh
description: End-to-end encrypted emergency messaging. Offline-first. No server required.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix crypto && npm install --prefix tools
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.lint: eslint crypto tools tests app/src bluetooth node-server/**/*.js
scripts.lint:fix: eslint crypto tools tests app/src bluetooth node-server/**/*.js --fix
scripts.validate:local: npm run gate:lint-typecheck:local && npm run gate:test:unit && npm run gate:test:integration && npm run gate:compat && npm run gate:e2e:smoke && npm run check:backups
scripts.validate:ci: npm run gate:lint-typecheck:ci && npm run gate:test:unit && npm run gate:test:integration && npm run gate:compat && npm run gate:e2e:ci-critical && npm run gate:e2e:ci-extra-browser
scripts.gate:lint-typecheck:local: npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.gate:lint-typecheck:ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:runtime
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:crypto && npm run test:vectors
scripts.test:integration: node tests/integration/ble-crypto.test.js && node tests/integration/group-messaging.test.js && node tests/integration/contact-verification-policy.test.js && node tests/integration/group-verification-policy.test.js && node tests/integration/store-maintenance.test.js && node tests/integration/mesh-router.test.js && node tests/integration/ble-mesh-relay.test.js && node tests/integration/mesh-router-phase2.test.js && node tests/integration/app-runtime-mesh.test.js && node tests/integration/gatt-server.test.js && node tests/integration/node-server-relay.test.js && node tests/integration/node-server-relay-ops.test.js && node tests/integration/operator-panel.test.js && node tests/integration/db-migration-normalize.test.js && node tests/integration/share-target-intake-routing.test.js
scripts.test:e2e:real-browser: npm run test:e2e:install && npm run test:e2e:playwright
scripts.audit:pq: node crypto/audit.js --path . --format json | node -e "process.stdin|0" 2>/dev/null || node crypto/audit.js --path . --format text
scripts.release:check: npm run validate && npm run audit:security && npm run check:backups

author: Lifeline Mesh Contributors
